bonus.text: B-Boy Atu, Atunaisa Laqeretabua, holds a WDSF breaking licence representing Fiji. He placed 36th at the 2023 continental championship in Sydney and 30th in Brisbane in January 2026.
The Manua ni Ranadi, a spear meke telling the Queen’s sea journey from England, was danced for Elizabeth II in Suva in 1953. On 4 June 2026, the men of Vaturova revived it.
On 10 October 1970, as Prince Charles handed Fiji its independence documents at Albert Park, Suva, a group from Kalabu Primary School performed a meke for the ceremony.
